title: SII Vol. 9 No. 707 — Paideti
location_detail: On a stone set up in a field to the south of the village, Paideti, Hindupur Taluk, Anantapur District
date_text: The characters of the record belong to the 8th or 9th century A.D
summary: It refers to a certain Anniga Dhananjaya and a son of Mahesvara-Sahani and records the grant by Anniga of a kalnadu to a hero with admiration at his recapture of the lifted cattle and a gift of land to a Bhattaraka (god?)

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 709 — Kambaduru
location_detail: On a pillar in the inner court-yard of the Mallikarjuna temple at Kambaduru, Kalyanadrug Taluk, same District
date_text: The characters belong to the 12th century A.D
summary: This is not dated but refers itself to the reign of Irungonadeva

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 710 — Bagali
location_detail: On a slab set up on the right side of the southern entrance to the central shrine of the Kallesvara temple at Bagali, Harapanahalli Taluk, Bellary District
summary: This is dated in the cyclic year Hemalambi, Jyeshtha, ba. 8, Budhavara, which is not verifiable

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 711 — Ambali
location_detail: On the Mandapa in front of the Kallesvara temple at Ambali, Kudligi Taluk, Same District
summary: This is dated the cyclic year Paridhavi, Asvayuja (not verifiable)

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 712 — Bagali

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 713 — Hampi
location_detail: On the Eastern wall of the Vitthalasvami temple at Hampi, Hospet Taluk, Bellary District
summary: It records the sadaseve of Timmarasa, Chennarasayya and Divakarayya

title: SII Vol. 9 No. 714 — Agali
location_detail: On The South Wall Of The Sankaresvarasvami Temple At Agali, Madakasira Taluk, Anantapur District
summary: It records that Kachapodeya bestowed the talavarike of the village Agali on Talavara Dodda, son of Hulikunte-Chandanayaka
